# tx_sender_module — EVM Transaction Sender

> The one EVM transaction sender on the device: one nonce ledger, call bundles approved as one decision in the keystore, ordered broadcast, and a write-ahead local history. Holds no key material and chooses no chain.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `prepare` | `prepare(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Price a bundle of calls without doing anything: one `fee_module` bundle estimate, the account's ether against the value plus the fee ceiling, and the nonce the first call would take. |
| `send` | `send(request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Ask a human to approve a bundle. |
| `send_status` | `send_status(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Advance a pending send and report where it got to. |
| `cancel_send` | `cancel_send(request_id: tstr) -> tstr` | Withdraw a send that has not been approved yet, releasing its reserved nonces. |
| `live_sends` | `live_sends() -> tstr` | Every send that could still move and is not stuck: `{ ok, sends: [{ requestId, handle, chainId, from, status, origin, purpose }] }`. |
| `history` | `history(address: tstr, chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Locally recorded transactions for `address`, newest first, on `chain_id` — or on every chain when it is 0. |
| `refresh_pending` | `refresh_pending(address: tstr) -> tstr` | Poll receipts for this address's still-pending transactions, on each row's OWN chain, and update their stored status. |
| `refresh_tx_status` | `refresh_tx_status(address: tstr, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | Re-read one recorded transaction's receipt on ITS OWN chain and update the stored status. |
| `tx_details` | `tx_details(address: tstr, hash_hex: tstr) -> tstr` | The transaction- and block-level fields a RECEIPT does not carry, for one recorded transaction. |

| Event | Payload | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `send_status_changed` | `send_status_changed(request_id: tstr)` | A pending send changed state — approved, rejected, broadcast or failed. |
| `tx_status_changed` | `tx_status_changed(hash_hex: tstr)` | A recorded transaction took a hash or a receipt settled it. |
| `history_changed` | `history_changed(address: tstr)` | A recorded row for `address` appeared or changed with no hash for `tx_status_changed` to name — a call is written to history BEFORE it is broadcast, and on the arm where the node returns no hash it never gets one. |
